description: This file contains functions and imports related to handling mentions, URLs, file content extraction, diagnostics, and terminal output within a VSCode extension or similar environment. It manages parsing mentions in text, fetching content from files, URLs, git, and terminal, and exporting relevant functions.

methods.name: getUrlErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly error message based on the error encountered during URL fetch attempts.

methods.name: openMention
methods.description: Handles opening or revealing a mention, which can be a file path, URL, or special command like 'problems' or 'terminal'.

methods.name: parseMentions
methods.description: Parses a text string for mentions and commands, fetches associated content, and formats the output with embedded content blocks.

methods.name: getFileOrFolderContent
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the content of a specified file or directory, respecting ignore rules and handling binary/image files.

methods.name: getWorkspaceProblems
methods.description: Retrieves current workspace diagnostics (errors and warnings) as a formatted string.

methods.name: getLatestTerminalOutput
methods.description: Captures and returns the current content of the active terminal in VSCode.
